Definition: properly, to hiss, i.e. whisper a (magic) spell; generally, to prognosticate
BiblicalUsage: 1) to practice divination, divine, observe signs, learn by experience, diligently observe, practice fortunetelling, take as an omen; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to practice divination; 1a2) to observe the signs or omens
